title: Jehovah God! Thy Gracious Power
description: Jehovah God! Thy Gracious Power in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: James Thomson wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 138 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “All-embracing Providence of God”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Je-ho-vah God! thy gra-cious power On ev-ery hand we see; O may the bless-ings of each hour Lead all our thoughts to thee.

lines: O may the blessings of each hour
Lead all our thoughts to thee.
If, on the wings of morn, we speed
Thy hand will there our footsteps lead,
Thy power is in the ocean deeps,
Thine eye of mercy never sleeps,
In all the varying scenes of time,
Through every age, in every clime,

licence: Public domain: James Thomson died in 1748.
credits: Words by James Thomson (1700–1748), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
